riskItems.capacitySensitiveUncertainty: A mask based only on pale color could wrongly count these solids as walkable paving. The sloped image projection does not determine real width, height or exact ground contact.
riskItems.rootValidationNeeded: Mark both plinth and side stone as candidate solid footprints separately from tread/ground surfaces, then test the front approach and lateral bypass in world coordinates. Do not alter the artwork from this risk flag alone.
